newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile complains to Bolivia over minister's remarks.
newsitem.headline: Chile complains to Bolivia over minister's remarks.

text.p: Chile protested to Bolivia on Tuesday over claims by Bolivian Foreign Minister Antonio Aranibar that opposition from Chile's military leaders prevented the resolution of a long border dispute.
"It wasn't a written note, (but) was simply a verbal manifestation of our annoyance over this whole incident," Foreign Minister Jose Miguel Insulza said.
He was speaking after a meeting between Bolivian consul German Antello and foreign ministry officials over the diplomatic spat caused by Aranibar's comments.
Aranibar said last week that opposition from former military ruler General Augusto Pinochet, still commander in chief of the army, was one reason for Chilean refusal to resolve the frontier dispute.
Landlocked Bolivia has long tried to persuade Chile to return land won in the 1879 War of the Pacific which would give it access to the Pacific coast.
The border was fixed by a treaty in 1904. Chile has refused to discuss returning land to Bolivia, although it has offered to improve road and rail links.
